title: At the Reservoir, the Khalsa Hold the Line So the Caravan Can Drink

blocks.text: After miles of flight under the summer sun, both Sikhs and Pathans are near collapse from thirst and realize that no water is available ahead for a long distance. When a reservoir finally appears, the whole field surges toward it as if life itself has suddenly returned.

The Khalsa leadership refuses to let the caravan dissolve into panic at the water's edge. Instead, the Khalsa Singhs stand guard and protect the Sikh caravan even at the cost of their lives, making sure the defenseless and exhausted can drink before the attackers turn the pause into slaughter.

For a brief moment both sides drink water from the same source, but the truce is only accidental and temporary. As soon as the thirst eases, the Singhs resume armed protection of the caravan and prepare for the struggle to continue.
